item.title: Review: UK Homebuilders Fall as First Time Buyer Support Disappoints
item.description: Shares in the UK’s largest homebuilders slumped Wednesday after the government unveiled fresh details of a new policy designed to help people buy their first home that showed it expected to lend far less than a previous program.
